title: StateTune: Transforming LLM-Assisted EDA Flow Tuning into a Stateful, Closed-Loop Process
abstract: arXiv:2608.23601v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: EDA flow parameter tuning is critical for quality-of-results~(QoR), yet the parameter space is large, tightly coupled, and full evaluations are prohibitively expensive. Prior LLM-assisted tuners mainly use the LLM as an external proposer with transient working context; we instead present \textbf{StateTune}, which reformulates LLM-assisted EDA tuning as a closed-loop, state-carrying process. Its optimizer state is a typed, evidence-gated \emph{persistent optimization memory} that is updated by every evaluation and shared between candidate generation and budget allocation. On top of this optimizer state, an expected hypervolume improvement (EHVI)-guided, runtime-aware promotion policy ranks quick-stage candidates by expected Pareto frontier gain per unit of runtime cost. Evaluated on a Cadence industrial flow across six benchmark blocks (two technology nodes \(\times\) three designs), against five baselines including LLM+retrieval-augmen

translated_title: StateTune：将LLM辅助的EDA流程调优转变为有状态的闭环过程
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.23601v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：EDA流程参数调优对结果质量（QoR）至关重要，然而参数空间庞大、耦合紧密，且全面评估成本过高。先前的LLM辅助调优器主要将LLM用作具有临时工作上下文的外部提议者；我们则提出\textbf{StateTune}，将LLM辅助的EDA调优重新定义为闭环、携带状态的过程。其优化器状态是一种类型化、证据门控的\textit{持久优化记忆}，由每次评估更新，并在候选生成和预算分配之间共享。在此优化器状态之上，一种基于期望超体积改进（EHVI）引导、运行时感知的晋升策略，根据单位运行时成本上的预期帕累托前沿增益对快速阶段候选进行排名。在Cadence工业流程上，跨六个基准模块（两个技术节点×三个设计）进行评估，与包括LLM+检索增强在内的五种基线相比……
tldr: 本文提出StateTune，通过引入持久优化记忆和EHVI引导的运行时感知晋升策略，将LLM辅助的EDA调优转化为有状态的闭环过程，从而提升调优效率和结果质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes StateTune, which transforms LLM-assisted EDA tuning into a stateful, closed-loop process via persistent optimization memory and an EHVI-guided runtime-aware promotion policy, improving tuning efficiency and QoR.
